name: Create Simple Machines Diagrams
description:
A 3rd-grade science teacher needs a visual aid flipchart to introduce Simple Machines. Create a 3-page ActivInspire flipchart with the following structure:

Page 1 — Overview: Title 'Simple Machines' and a list of these six types: Lever, Wheel and Axle, Pulley, Inclined Plane, Wedge, Screw.

Page 2 — The Lever: Title 'The Lever', definition text 'A rigid bar resting on a pivot', and a diagram constructed using shapes (a triangle for the fulcrum, a rectangle/line for the beam, and a shape for the load). Add text labels 'Fulcrum' and 'Load'.

Page 3 — The Inclined Plane: Title 'The Inclined Plane', definition text 'A flat supporting surface tilted at an angle', and a diagram using shapes (a triangle for the ramp and a shape for the object). Add the text label 'Ramp'.

Save the completed flipchart as /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/simple_machines_lesson.flipchart
